SCENE ONE - OPENING

1. EXT. PORT MERIDIAN / INT. THE LAST POCKET - NIGHT

CAMERA: Start against rain-streaked glass, then travel beside the rail.
LIGHT: Steel-blue shiplight; steady amber practicals.
SOUND: Rain and engines felt through the floor.

ISA rolls a ferry token across her knuckles. A sleeve crease remains on her cheek.

SCENE TWO - NO SIDE BETS

2. INT. THE LAST POCKET - UNDER THE RAIL - CONTINUOUS

CAMERA: Low, under the rail, a coin passing in the foreground.
MOOD: The room has places to sit.

KES places a second coin beside hers.
